podcast.body: This song reached number one on various dance club music charts in 1978. It originated from chords by Tipwerex, with Sylvester adding words and melody spontaneously. Though he initially thought the song wasn't "that hot" due to few words, he found them to perfectly describe the feeling of dancing, sweating, cruising, and carrying on. The song has since been featured in numerous movies, video games, and documentaries. In 2019, the Library of Congress selected it for preservation in the National Recording Registry for its joyous embodiment of pride. "In 2019, the Library of Congress selected you make me feel mighty real for preservation in the national recording registry as it should be."
